en:
Is something the matter? Please rest and
try to regain as much strength as you can.

Escaping this place will prove to be quite
difficult... Best not to fret over it.

If you really can't fall asleep, I'll put you 
to sleep with a magic hammer.

*sigh*... Seeing it like this, the school 
really is eerie.

It's an interesting place in the day, but...
having to stay the night is too much.
